simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查名词辨析。句意：这家餐馆越来越出名是由于它做的各种各样的食物适应各类人群。a wide range of意为“各种各样的”。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: This restaurant has become popular for its wide______ of foods that suit all tastes and pockets.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查介词短语辨析。句意：对于一个公职官员来说，要求人们送礼或送钱来换取对他们的帮助是非法的。in addition to除……之外；in place of代替；in honour of向……表示敬意；in exchange for交换。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: It is illegal for a public official to ask people for gifts or money______favors to them.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查冠词辨析。句意：欣赏上海世博会带给人们的快乐，是一种非常好的感觉。feeling前有形容词修饰，故加不定冠词。pleasure作“快乐，欢乐”讲为不可数名词。故选B项。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: It's______good feeling for people to admire the Shanghai World Expo that gives them______ pleasure.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查非谓语动词。句意：地震发生后，大量的营救人员夜以继日地为青海省玉树县提供补给。该空为现在分词短语作伴随状语，故选A项。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: Lots of rescue workers were working around the clock,______supplies to Yushu,Qinghai province after the earthquake.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查情态动词的用法。句意：杰克把他的父亲描述为一个意志坚定的人，他的父亲多年前肯定很勇敢。用must have been表示对过去事情的肯定推测。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: Jack described his father,who______ a brave boy many years ago,as a strong-willed man.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查非谓语动词。句意：他的声音如此之大，以至于在房间的另一头都能听到。such…as意为“如此……以至于”，且be heard是指他的声音被别人听到，故选A。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: He spoke in such a high voice______at the farther end of the room.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查连词辨析。句意：格拉斯哥的消费在英国是最低的，然而，生活质量有可能是最高的一个。while在此处是一个表示转折意义的连词，意为“然而”，表示the cost of living与the quality of life的对比。since引导原因状语从句，意为“因为”；when引导时间状语从句，意为“当……的时候”；as可以引导时间状语从句也可引导原因状语从句。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: The cost of living in Glasgow is among the lowest in Britain,______the quality of life is probably one of the highest.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查日常交际用语。句意：——非常抱歉，我把你的桌布弄脏了。——没关系。Never mind“没关系”，是回答对方道歉的用语；Sorry“对不起”，是向对方道歉的用语；Don’t mention it“不要再提它了”，是回答对方感谢的用语；That's all right“没关系，不客气”，是回答对方感谢的用语。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title:
—I'm terribly sorry that I made your table cloth dirty.
—____________.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查时态和主谓一致。句意：这家公司大约有2台笔记本电脑，但是只有三分之一经常被使用。一般来讲，分数作主语时，谓语用单数。但是由前半句about 20 notebook computers可知，此处用复数。本句的时态是过去时，因此应该用were。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: The company had about 20 notebook computers,but only one-third______used regularly.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查形容词比较级。句意：这一个是两个中较好的。两者进行比较，不用最高级，排除A项。B、D两项不与of连用，后多接than。表示“两者中比较……的一个”，多用定冠词+比较级+of。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: This one is______of the two.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查情态动词和虚拟语气。句意：当我们到达车站的时候，火车还没有到达，因此我们本不必这么匆忙。根据句意，后半句应用虚拟语气。needn’t have done意为“本不必”。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: When we reached the station the train had not arrived yet;so we______.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查时态和语态。句意：请保持安静行吗？我想听正在广播的天气报告。说话间正在发生的动作，应用进行时，同时表示被动含义，故选B。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: Would you please keep silent?The weather report______and I want to listen.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查反义疑问句的用法。句意：我和你不可能在一起工作，是吗？根据陈述部分是肯定形式，疑问部分用否定形式；陈述部分是否定形式，疑问部分用肯定形式，陈述部分中含有否定词hardly,故疑问部分用肯定形式，又因为主语是you and I,故选D。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: You and I could hardly work together,______?

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查动词不定式的用法。句意：现在人们有时把他们的废物分开，以便其很容易被重复利用。重新利用是指将来发生的动作，而且是被动的。故选D。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: Nowadays people sometimes separate their waste to make it easier for it______.

simExamExerciseListPage.analyze: 【应试指导】本题考查名词性从句的引导词。句意：她对我们来说是非常重要的，我们已经做好一切准备来拯救她的生命。whatever引导宾语从句，在从句中作宾语；用whichever引导，则表示“任何哪个”，与题意不符。
simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title: She is very dear to us.We have been prepared to do______it takes to save her life.

simExamExerciseListPage.prName: 成考高起专英语模拟题五
simExamExerciseListPage.title:
“Seasame Street'”has been called“the longest street in the world”.
  This is because the television program by that name can now be seen in so many parts of the world.
  The program,which went on the air in New York in 1969,uses songs,jokes,and pictures to give children a basic understanding of numbers,letters and human relationships.More than 6 million children in the United States watch it regularly.The viewers（观众）include more than half the nation's children before school age.
  Many teachers consider the program a great help,though some teachers find that problems happen when the first-year pupils who have learned from“Seasame Street”are in the same class with those who have not watched the program.Tests have shown that children who watch it five times a week learn more than those who seldom watch it.In the United States the program is shown at different hours during the week in order to increase the number of children who can watch it regularly.
  Why has“Seasame Street”been so much more successful than other children's shows?Many reasons have been suggested.Perhaps one reason is that mothers watch“Seasame Street”along with their children.But the best reason for the success of the program may be that it makes every child watching it feel able to learn.The child finds himself learning,and he wants to learn more.
People call“Seasame Street”the longest street in the world because______.

simExamExerciseListPage.title:
A young woman rode with her new husband in a wagon（四轮马车）.They came to a log cabin（小木屋）.The man shouted and a little boy came running out of the cabin.Sarah,the young woman,got down from the wagon,opened wide her arms and held the boy close.
   “Hello,Abe Lincoln,”she said.“I think we'll be good friends.”
  The new mother with the smiling face went to work at once.She washed Abe and his sister and tidied（弄整齐）their hair.And that night she threw away the boy's mattress（床垫）of leaves and gave him a soft mattress and enough blankets to keep him warm at night.
  Sarah wove cloth and made new shirts for Abe.She made him new deerskin trousers and even deerskin shoes.
  Maybe,if she hadn't come to the cabin,he wouldn't have lived to be a man.When Abe's father told him not to go to school any more and help on the farm,Sarah took Abe's part against his father.Abe would rather read than eat,and when his father told him to stop,Sarah said,“Let the boy read.”
  In 1830 the day came when Abe would leave home to work in New Salem.For the last time she had taken Abe's part against his father.For the last time she had kept the cabin quiet so that Abe could read.
  More than twenty years later,when Abe,who had then become famous,was going to make a speech in a nearby town,Sarah went there just to watch him.In the crowd she tried to make herself small,but he saw her,and in front of everybody,got out of his carriage and went over and put his arms around her and kissed her.Yes,that was her Abe.

simExamExerciseListPage.title:
A young woman rode with her new husband in a wagon（四轮马车）.They came to a log cabin（小木屋）.The man shouted and a little boy came running out of the cabin.Sarah,the young woman,got down from the wagon,opened wide her arms and held the boy close.
   “Hello,Abe Lincoln,”she said.“I think we'll be good friends.”
  The new mother with the smiling face went to work at once.She washed Abe and his sister and tidied（弄整齐）their hair.And that night she threw away the boy's mattress（床垫）of leaves and gave him a soft mattress and enough blankets to keep him warm at night.
  Sarah wove cloth and made new shirts for Abe.She made him new deerskin trousers and even deerskin shoes.
  Maybe,if she hadn't come to the cabin,he wouldn't have lived to be a man.When Abe's father told him not to go to school any more and help on the farm,Sarah took Abe's part against his father.Abe would rather read than eat,and when his father told him to stop,Sarah said,“Let the boy read.”
  In 1830 the day came when Abe would leave home to work in New Salem.For the last time she had taken Abe's part against his father.For the last time she had kept the cabin quiet so that Abe could read.
  More than twenty years later,when Abe,who had then become famous,was going to make a speech in a nearby town,Sarah went there just to watch him.In the crowd she tried to make herself small,but he saw her,and in front of everybody,got out of his carriage and went over and put his arms around her and kissed her.Yes,that was her Abe.
  “He loved me truly,”she said later.
